text: We tried this out on one of our 4 Shopify stores. It works really well. We are now installing it on the other 3 stores. I am glad someone has come up with something to help Shopify sellers combat the bot attacks. Between this app and Cloudflare we have been having a lot of success minimizing the attacks.

There are more complex solutions, but this one was easy enough for me to set up as an extremely busy business owner focused on other more pressing things.

text: My small business was being bombarded by bots that were going straight to checkout. Once these bots "started checkout" (they rarely complete checkout), my Klaviyo welcome emails were being sent 30 mins later. My deliverability score went from 99.5% to 42% in 2 weeks. Once I installed this, 4024 bots were stopped in one week and only 1 bot got through. My deliverability score has rebounded a bit to 54%. Hopefully it will rebound more before BFCM. This is an excellent app to add and the customer service is very responsive. Highly recommend the $9 per month.

Excellent support and genuinely honest advice We contacted CartWatch while dealing with a serious Shopify bot attack involving direct cart permalink URLs and synthetic abandoned checkouts. Although we ultimately resolved the issue using a separate firewall solution, the support from Shaya at CartWatch was excellent. They took the time to understand the exact attack pattern, clearly explained what CartWatch could and couldn’t intercept, and were completely honest about Shopify’s platform limitations rather than trying to oversell the app. They even offered to personally review the bot activity if we installed the free plan for diagnostics. We didn’t end up needing to keep the app installed, but the quality of the support absolutely deserves 5 stars. Very knowledgeable, responsive and refreshingly transparent.
Really good experience with the app, been using it for a while and I don't regret it.
